leadText:
The unnamed island is an -exclusive location in the Kanto region that appeared in Beach Blank Out Blastoise!. It is located close to Cinnabar Island.

 and first learned of the island after they bumped into a concerned on one of Cinnabar Island's beaches. Upon arrival, the island's sandy shores were covered in Turtle Pokémon fast inside their shells. 's helped wake the wild Pokémon up, while Ash's Squirtle put on its black sunglasses and took charge of the situation. 

 was able to translate the Wartortle and 's story into a pictorial presentation which detailed that the Turtle Pokemon's King went out swimming and later washed ashore asleep and before long the drowsiness spread to the other Pokémon. was later revealed to be the cause after it became stuck inside one of Blastoise's cannons.

 attempted to steal Blastoise several times with their mecha Gyarados, but were sent out to sea and their submarine exploded underwater. 

The island is uninhabited by people and not marked on any map. The tropical location features a large rock formation that resembles a Squirtle shell, and its shoreline is dotted with palm trees.
